messages.subject: Harrow Precision Engineering Limited v Brevdale Castings Limited - Letter of Claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Hargrove,

We act for Harrow Precision Engineering Limited. Please find attached our letter of claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Construction and Engineering Disputes, concerning defective ductile-iron pump housing castings supplied by your client under the Supply Agreement dated 9 January 2023.

The letter sets out the basis of the claim and the loss, presently quantified at £1,421,650. We require a response within 14 days. The enclosures referred to (including the Wraysbury report) can be provided on confirmation that you are instructed.

Yours sincerely,
James Osei

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Harrow Precision Engineering Limited v Brevdale Castings Limited - Letter of Claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

We confirm that we act for Brevdale Castings Limited. We acknowledge your letter of claim and will provide a substantive response in accordance with the Protocol. We anticipate that liability will be in issue, in particular as to the representativeness of the Wraysbury sampling and the causal role of your client's own machining and proof-testing.

Please forward the enclosures.

Kind regards,
Rachel Hargrove
Hargrove & Associates LLP
